source_text: The present invention relates to composite elements comprising (i) plastic, adhering to which there is (ii) a polyisocyanate polyaddition product, where the polyisocyanate polyaddition product is obtained by mixing (a) isocyanate with (b) compounds having groups reactive toward isocyanates, (c) catalysts, (d) if desired, blowing agent, and (e) if desired, further additives, to give a reaction mixture, and permitting the reaction mixture to complete its reaction to give the polyisocyanate polyaddition product, where the compounds (b) having groups reactive toward isocyanates comprise a polyester polyalcohol as adhesion promoter, which can be prepared by polycondensation of an acid component and of one or more low-molecular-weight diols whose molecular weight is less than 500 g/mol, in excess, where the acid component comprises 83 to 97 mol% of adipic acid and 3 to 17 mol% of phthalic acid, isophthalic acid and/or terephthalic acid. The present invention further relates to composite elements comprising (i) plastic, adhering to which there is (ii) a polyisocyanate polyaddition product, where the polyisocyanate polyaddition product is obtained by mixing (a) isocyanate with (b) compounds having groups reactive toward isocyanates, (c) catalysts, (d) if desired, blowing agent, and (e) if desired, further additives, to give a reaction mixture, and permitting the reaction mixture to complete its reaction to give the polyisocyanate polyaddition product, where the compounds (b) having groups reactive toward isocyanates comprise a polyester polyalcohol as adhesion promoter, preparable by polycondensation of an acid component and one or more low-molecular-weight diols having a molecular weight of less than 500 g/mol, in excess, the low-molecular-weight diols containing 5 to 66 mol% of 1,3âpropanediol, based on the total amount of the diol. The present invention also relates to a process for the production of these composite elements, and to components in the fitting-out of aircraft, of vehicles, or of buildings, and to insulation systems comprising this type of composite element.

source_text: Process for the conversion of heavy feedstocks comprising the following steps: mixing the heavy feedstock with a suitable hydrogenation catalyst and sending the mixture obtained to a first hydrotreatment area (HT1) to which hydrogen or a mixture of hydrogen and H2S are introduced; sending the effluent stream from the first hydrotreatment area (HT1), containing the hydrotreatment reaction product and the catalyst in dispersed phase, to a first distillation area (D1) having one or more flash steps and/or atmospheric distillation and/or vacuum distillation whereby the various fractions coming from the hydrotreatment reaction are separated; sending at least part of the distillation residue (tar) or liquid leaving the flash unit of the first distillation area (D1), containing the catalyst in dispersed phase, rich in metalic sulfides produced by demetallation of the feedstock and optionally minimum quantities of coke, to a deasphalting area (SDA) in the presence of solvents or to a physical separation area, obtaining, in the case of the deasphalting area, two streams, one consisting of deasphalted oil (DAO), the other containing asphaltenes at least partially recycled to the first hydrotreatment area, in the case of the physical separation area, the solids separated and a liquid stream; sending the stream consisting of deasphalted oil (DAO) or the liquid stream separated in the physical separation area to a second hydrotreatment area (HT2), to which hydrogen or a mixture of hydrogen and H2S and a suitable hydrogenation catalyst are introduced; sending the effluent stream from the second hydrotreatment area (HT2), containing the hydrotreatment reaction product and the catalyst in dispersed phase, to a second distillation area (D2) having one or more flash and/or distillation steps whereby the various fractions coming from the second hydrotreatment area are separated; recycling at least part of the distillation residue or liquid leaving the flash unit of the second distillation area (D2), containing the catalyst in dispersed phase to the second hydrotreatment area (HT2).
target_text: Procedimiento para la conversión de materiales de alimentación pesados, que comprende los siguientes pasos: mezclar el material de alimentación pesado con un catalizador de hidrogenación adecuado y enviar la mezcla obtenida a una primera área de hidrotratamiento (HT1) en la cual se introduce hidrógeno o una mezcla de hidrógeno y H2S; enviar la corriente efluente de la primera área de hidrotratamiento (HT1), que contiene al producto de reacción del hidrotratamiento y al catalizador en fase dispersa, hacia una primera área de destilación (D1) que tiene uno o más pasos de destello y/o destilación atmosférica y/o destilación al vació, con lo cual se separan las diversas fracciones que vienen de la reacción de hidrotratamiento; enviar al menos parte del residuo de la destilación (alquitrán) o del líquido que sale de la unidad de destello de la primera área de destilación (D1), que contiene al catalizador en fase dispersa, rica en sulfuros metálicos producidos por la desmetalización del material de alimentación y opcionalmente cantidades mínimas de coque, hacia un área de desasfaltado (SDA) en presencia de solventes o a un área de separación física, obteniendo, en el caso del área de desasfaltado, dos corrientes, una consistente de aceite desasfaltado (DAO), la otra conteniendo asfaltenos al menos parcialmente reciclados hacia la primera área de hidrotratamiento, en el caso del área de separación física, los sólidos separados y una corriente líquida; enviar la corriente consistente de aceite desasfaltado (DAO) o la corriente líquida separada en el área de separación física hacia una segunda área de hidrotratamiento (HT2), a la cual se introduce hidrógeno o una mezcla de hidrógeno y H2S y un catalizador de hidrogenación adecuado; enviar la corriente efluente de la segunda área de hidrotratamiento (HT2), que contiene al producto de reacción del hidrotratamiento y al catalizador en fase dispersa, hacia una segunda área de destilación (D2) que tiene uno o más pasos de destello y/o de destilación, con lo cual se separan las diversas fracciones que vienen de la segunda área de hidrotratamiento; reciclar al menos parte del residuo de la destilación o del líquido que sale de la unidad de destello de la segunda área de destilación (D2), que contiene al catalizado en fase dispersa, hacia la segunda área de hidrotratamiento (HT2).

source_text: Composite foam profile section featuring an open-air expanded polyester foam core with a density of up to 250 kg/m3, preferably 40 to 150 kg/m3, more particularly from 50 to 100 kg/m3, and having on at least one of its surfaces a functional element applied by means of the so-called collateral coextrusion, the functional element being selected preferably in a sealing element, a mounting element, a fixing or connecting element, a reinforcing or stiffening element, a protection element, a dimensioning element, a decorative element, a covering or finishing element, or combinations thereof, and the composite foam profile section is manufactured by a method of manufacturing a composite foam profile section comprising the following steps: a) Dosing of the components of the foam core, in premix or individually dosed, in the feeding device of a first extruder; b) Plastification and mixing of the components of the foam core at high temperature to melt and homogenize these components; c) Introduction of a foaming gas and homogenization of the components of the foam core and of the gas; d) Cooling of the mass obtained; e) Extrusion of this mass into the open air through a die with a controlled temperature, which has a predetermined transverse shape, thus causing the formation of the foam core; f) Cooling the foam core; g) Dosing of the components of the functional element, in premix or dosed individually, in the feeding device of a second extruder; h) Plastification and mixing of the components of the functional element at high temperature to melt and homogenize these components; i) Cooling of the mass obtained; and j) Extrusion of this mass in the so-called collateral coextrusion die, this comprising guiding the foamy material core as a centering element for the mass, which comes from the collateral coextrusion die, which is temperature controlled and has a cross section by default, which causes the formation of the functional element through which an application is made to at least one surface of the foam core. b) Plastificación y mezcla de los componentes del núcleo de espuma a alta temperatura para fundir y homogeneizar estos componentes; c) Introducción de un gas espumante y homogeneización de los componentes del núcleo de espuma y del gas; d) Enfriamiento de la masa obtenida; e) Extrusión de esta masa al aire libre a través de un troquel de temperatura controlada, que presenta una forma transversal predeterminada, causando así la formación del núcleo de espuma; f) Enfriamiento del núcleo de espuma; g) Dosificación de los componentes del elemento funcional, en premezcla o dosificados individualmente, en el dispositivo de alimentación de una segunda extrusora; h) Plastificación y mezcla de los componentes del elemento funcional a alta temperatura para fundir y homogeneizar estos componentes; i) Enfriamiento de la masa obtenida; y j) Extrusión de esta masa en el llamado dado de coextrusión colateral, comprendiendo esto el guiado del núcleo de material espumoso como elemento de centrado para la masa, que procede del dado de coextrusión colateral, que es de temperatura controlada y que tiene una sección transversal de forma predeterminada, que provoca la formación del elemento funcional a través del cual se efectúa una aplicación en al menos una superficie del núcleo de material espumoso.

source_text: Procedure for the continuous refining and esterification of fatty materials, regardless of the origin of the raw material (specially designed for category 1 and 2 animal fats); which consists of treating it with an acid (preferably acetic acid for fats of animal origin and methanesulfonic acid for fats of vegetable origin), followed by an acid esterification process in special multistage continuous reactors. The peculiarity of the method object of the invention is that the esterification can be carried out in two stages in series or parallel according to the degree of acidity of the raw material (two stages in series for ffa greater than 50%, and two stages in parallel for ffa less than 50%, no acidity value being limited) continuously. Finally, a third phase is developed where the methanol, the dissolved oil phase and an aqueous phase are recovered, which are reused again. Thanks to the method, it is possible to reduce the content of free fatty acids and/or impurities of the original material continuously and without thermal or chemical degradation, for any type of raw material (raw, refined, partially refined, ...). This process improvement results in an increase in the final yields of biodiesel, in addition to the quality with which the product is obtained. By including the method as an additional stage in current biodiesel manufacturing technologies, or as a separate stage to them, it is possible to obtain a high quality liquid biofuel for use in diesel engines: i) in full (b100) ), ii) in mixture with diesel (content of biodiesel> 7%), or iii) as an additive of this (mixtures <7%), from waste, (among which we should highlight category 1 animal fats) and 2, the vegetable oleins and the pure fatty acids) giving a solution to the operation problem with which most of the biodiesel manufacturing plants are located on the one hand, and solving the environmental inconvenience that the administrations are currently facing. For the elimination of waste (especially in category 1 and 2 animal fats). (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
target_text: Procedimiento para el refinado y esterificación continua de materiales grasos, independientemente del origen de la materia prima (especialmente diseñado para grasas animales de categoría 1 y 2); que consiste en el tratamiento del mismo con un ácido (de preferencia ácido acético para grasas de origen animal y ácido metanosulfónico para grasas de origen vegetal), seguido de un proceso de esterificación ácida en reactores especiales multietapas continuos. La particularidad que presenta el método objeto de la invención, es que la esterificación puede desarrollarse en dos etapas en serie o paralelo según el grado de acidez de la materia prima (dos etapas en serie para FFA superiores al 50%, y dos etapas en paralelo para FFA menores al 50%, no siendo limitante ningún valor de acidez) de manera continua. Finalmente, se desarrolla una tercera fase donde se recupera el metanol, la fase oleosa disuelta y una fase acuosa, las cuales son reutilizadas nuevamente. Gracias al método, se consigue reducir el contenido en ácidos grasos libres y/o impurezas del material original de manen continua y sin degradación térmica ni química, para cualquier tipo de materia prima (cruda, refinada, parcialmente refinada, ...). Esta mejora de proceso origina un aumento en los rendimientos finales de biodiesel, además de la calidad con la que se obtiene el producto. Mediante la inclusión del método como una etapa adicional en las tecnologías de fabricación de biodiesel actuales, o bien como etapa independiente a las mismas, se permite obtener un biocombustible líquido de alta calidad para su empleo en motores diésel: i) de manera total (B100), ii) en mezcla con el gasóleo (contenido en biodiesel > 7%), o iii) como aditivo de éste (mezclas < 7%), a partir de residuos, (entre los que hay que destacar las grasas animales de categoría 1 y 2, las oleínas vegetales y los ácidos grasos puros) dando una solución al problema de operación con el que se encuentran la mayoría de las plantas de fabricación de Biodiesel por un lado, y resolviendo el inconveniente medioambiental con el que se enfrentan actualmente las administraciones para la eliminación de los residuos (especialmente en las grasas animales de categoría 1 y 2).

source_text: A bulk-doped semiconductor that is at least one of the following: a single crystal, an elongated and bulk-doped semiconductor that, at any point along its longitudinal axis, has a largest cross-sectional dimension less than 500 nanometers, and a free-standing and bulk-doped semiconductor with at least one portion having a smallest width of less than 500 nanometers. Such a semiconductor may comprise an interior core comprising a first semiconductor; and an exterior shell comprising a different material than the first semiconductor. Such a semiconductor may be elongated and may have, at any point along a longtiudinal section of such a semiconductor, a ratio of the length of the section to a longest width which is greater than 4:1, or greater than 10:1, or greater than 100:1, or even greater than 1000:1. At least one portion of such a semiconductor may a smallest width of less than 200 nanometers, or less than 150 nanometers, or less than 100 nanometers, or less than 80 nanometers, or less than 70 nanometers, or less than 60 nanometers, or less than 40 nanometers, or less than 20 nanometers, or less than 10 nanometers, or even less than 5 nanometers. Such a semiconductor may be a single crystal and may be free-standing. Such a semiconductor may be either lightly n-doped, heavily n-doped, lightly p-doped or heavily p-doped. Such a semiconductor may be doped during growth. Such a semiconductor may be part of a device, which may include any of a variety of devices and combinations thereof, and a variety of assembling techniques may be used to fabricate devices from such a semiconductor. Two or more of such a semiconductors, including an array of such semiconductors, may be combined to form devices, for example, to form a crossed p-n junction of a device. Such devices at certain sizes may exhibit quantum confinement and other quantum phenomena, and the wavelength of light emitted from one or more of such semiconductors may be controlled by selecting a width of such semiconductors. Such semiconductors and device made therefrom may be used for a variety of applications.

source_text: The modification of the surface chemistry of the adsorbents is one of the alternatives for increasing the removal performance thereof and reducing costs. For example, recent studies have analyzed the chemical modification of beef bone coal with different metal salts and Ce3 + and Ce4 + species to enhance the removal of fluorides. Said studies have shown that it is possible to increase up to an order of magnitude the adsorption of fluorides. However, the main limitation of this type of work is that modification studies have been carried out in agitated tanks where the adsorbent-solution contact times are substantial. To date, the effectiveness of these chemical modification procedures has not been evaluated under dynamic operating conditions. The aforementioned studies have used reagent-grade substances, which increase the cost of modification of the adsorbent and, consequently, affect the final price of the defluorination process. The aim of the present invention is to optimise the chemical properties of the beef bone coal to activate the adsorption potential thereof, using a fixed-bed column and commercial-grade aluminium sulphate to interact at a molecular level with the water fluorides for human consumption use, acting as a receptacle thereof and thus eliminating the impurities from the treated water. This reagent is commonly used in water treatment plants and its cost is very low, i.e. about 15 weights per kilogram. The application of this salt and said operation scheme has been analyzed to enhance the removal of fluorides from water with beef bone coal but with a low cost process. The chemical modification of the adsorbent is performed through an experimental design where the response variable is the ability to adsorb fluorides from the bone coal of enhanced beef with aluminum sulfate. The results show that Al2 (SO4) 3 modified adsorbent has a 232% increase in the adsorption of water fluorides. The results of this phase allow identifying the advantages of using commercial grade aluminum sulfate to enhance the defluorination of water with beef bone coal.
target_text: La modificación de la química de superficie de los adsorbentes es una de las alternativas para incrementar su desempeño de remoción y reducir costos. Por ejemplo, estudios recientes han analizado la modificación química del carbón de hueso de res con diferentes sales metálicas y especies de Ce3+ y Ce4+ para intensificar la remoción de fluoruros. Dichos estudios han demostrado que es posible incrementar hasta en un orden de magnitud la adsorción de fluoruros. No obstante, la principal limitante de este tipo de trabajos es que los estudios de modificación se han realizado en tanques agitados donde los tiempos de contacto adsorbente - solución son sustanciales. Hasta el momento, no se ha evaluado la efectividad de esos procedimientos de modificación química en condiciones de operación dinámicas. Los estudios mencionados han utilizado sustancias grado reactivo, las cuales incrementan el costo de modificación del adsorbente y, en consecuencia, afectan el precio final del proceso de defluoración. El objetivo de la presente invención es la optimización de las propiedades químicas del carbón de hueso de res para activar su potencial de adsorción, empleando una columna de lecho fijo y sulfato de aluminio grado comercial para interactuar a nivel molecular con los fluoruros del agua para uso de consumo humano actuando como un receptáculo de los mismos y así eliminar las impurezas de las aguas tratadas. Este reactivo es usado comúnmente en las plantas de tratamiento de agua y su costo es muy bajo, es decir, aproximadamente 15 pesos por kilogramo. Se ha analizado la aplicación de esta sal y dicho esquema de operación para intensificar la remoción de fluoruros del agua con carbón de hueso de res pero con un proceso de bajo costo. La modificación química del adsorbente es realizada a través de un diseño experimental donde la variable de respuesta es la capacidad de adsorción de fluoruros del carbón de hueso de res mejorado con sulfato de aluminio. Los resultados muestran para el adsorbente modificado con Al2(SO4)3 presenta un incremento del 232 % en la adsorción de fluoruros del agua. Los resultados de esta fase permiten identificar las ventajas de utilizar el sulfato de aluminio grado comercial para intensificar la defluoración del agua con carbón de hueso de res.

source_text: The present invention describes a method for obtaining compounds of the general formula below mentioned, where p, q, m and N can be modified upon ranging the amount of glycol and unsaturated anhydride and using a process consisting in a glycolysis stage, followed by an sterification stage for obtaining unsaturated polyesters, which can be photocured by the sun light without requiring the addition of unsaturated copolymers such as styrenic acrylics. The glycolysis stage consists in the trans-sterification of the polyesters such as polyethylene terephthalate (PET) with alcohols having from about 6 to about 20 carbon atoms, or a mixture thereof, containing alkylaryl groups or straight, branched or cyclic aralkyl groups (i.e., 1,8-octanodiol, triethylenglycol, propylene glycol, pentaerythritol, bisphenol-A), in the presence of a combination of tin, sodium and potassium catalysts at a temperature ranging from about 150¦C to about 250¦C in a solvent suitable for entraining the ethylenglycol released therefrom. Said process preferably uses a waste PET, although the method may be applied to any PET. The process differs from the patented processes US5121064 and US5319128 as follows: the nature of the catalyst, the ethylenglycol carrier and the combination of: catalyst/ethylenglycol carrier/reactor volume, for improving the efficacy and time of the trans-sterification reaction. The second stage of the process consists in the use of diesters or anhydrides or unsaturated acids (i.e., maleic anhydride, fumaric acid, itaconic acid and chloride-maleic acid), in the presence of a combination of tin, sodium and potassium catalysts at a temperature ranging from about 150¦C to about 250¦C, but preferably ranging from about 120¦C to about 180¦C, in a solvent suitable for entraining the water generated therefrom. The process differs from the patented processes US6,512,046, US 6,127,436 in that the unsaturated polyester does not require to be mixed together with acrylate or styrene pol ymers or copolymers so as to be fhotocurable and/or obtain resistant and flexible products.

source_text: Wrapper of 100% recycled paper of the semi Kraft type developed for containing organic waists coated with a cohesive surface treatment based on natural rubber mixed with resins and salts, which formula is 100% natural and biodegradable. Semi Kraft type paper of 95 gr/m2, which is 100% made of recycled fibre, coated in one surface thereof with 17 gr/m2 of a cohesive based on rubber, resins and further natural components which formula is a trade secret, using embossed paper for providing flexibility and texture to the wrapper. The invention is presented in rolls which are perforated for facilitating the use thereof in sheets of different sizes. Since the cellulose of the 100% recycled paper of the semi Kraft type of 95 gr/m2 has been previously used in the manufacture of other paper products, the cellulose of the Kraft type is repulped so as to manufacture paper of 95 gr/m2. Once the paper base is manufactured, one surface is coated with a mixture of natural centrifuged rubber, pine tur pentine resin, sodium silicate and minimum amounts of stabilisers and antioxidants and dispersants, so as to produce a cohesive gum (only adhered to itself without reaching the adhesive degree). The natural rubber provides a sealing and waterproof barrier located in one surface of the paper. The coating would be sufficiently effective in the aforementioned properties if the coating is applied in amounts of from about 34gr/m2, a coating of 17 gr/m2 being formed after the aqueous base of the mass is dried. The accurate formula remains as trade secret. The main use of the invention, in virtue of being a recycled paper with chemical and physical characteristics of water resistance, flexibility and hermeticity, is to separate in an efficient manner the organic wastes from the inorganic wastes, since in many occasions the organic waste, specially those emitting unpleasant odours, are wastes wrapped in one or several plastic bags, which invariably end in the sanitary landfills, thereby pollu ting the environment and not contributing to the task of efficiently protecting the same.

source_text: The present disclosure is related to the procedure for obtaining a corrosion inhibitor for polyducts based on three main stages: (1) elaborating the imidazoline; (2) preparing the asset (carboxy-imidazoline), and (3) formulating the asset (carboxy-imidazoline). The first stage corresponds to obtaining the imidazoline precursor derived from sunflower oil and EDTA. The second stage consists of modifying of imidazoline to obtain the asset (carboxy-imidazoline). Finally, the third stage consists of formulating of the asset with xylenes and isopropyl alcohol to obtain the corrosion inhibitor for the polyducts. In this regard, it should be noted that the improvement of the present procedure lies in reducing the manufacturing time, maintaining the quality and efficiency of the inhibitor, with which, the final product will be obtained at a lower cost. During the process of the present invention, the reduction of the manufacturing time is likely to be carried out in: the manufacturing stage of the imidazoline; the preparation stage of the asset (carboxy-imidazoline); the reaction period for obtaining the asset; the cooling procedure of each stage of the synthesis; the addition of xylenes at a temperature of around 110°C after the obtaining stage of the imidazoline; the addition of xylenes at a temperature of around 110°C after the obtaining stage of the carboxy-imidazoline; the addition of xylenes at temperatures between 60 and 110°C during the formulation stage of the corrosion inhibitor; and the addition of isopropyl alcohol at a temperature of 55°C during the formulation stage of the corrosion inhibitor. With the improvement that this procedure represents , the collection time has been reduced up to 11 hours, maintaining the quality and protection efficiency based on the NACE TM-0172 and NACE ID182 methods, the latter, both in bitter (H2S) and sweet (CO2) media. The results obtained in the industrial scaling of this corrosion inhibitor, makes the product competitive at commercial level and with application perspectives both in Mexico and in other countries.
target_text: El procedimiento de obtención del inhibidor de corrosión para poliductos de la presente invención, se basa en tres etapas principales: (1) elaboración de la imidazolina; (2) elaboración del activo (carboxi-imidazolina), y (3) formulación del activo (carboxi-imidazolina). La primera etapa corresponde a la obtención del precursor imidazolina derivado del aceite de girasol y EDTA, la segunda etapa consiste en la modificación de la imidazolina para la obtención del activo (carboxi-imidazolina) y por último, la tercera etapa consiste en la formulación del activo con xilenos e isopropanol para obtener el inhibidor de corrosión para poliductos. A este respecto, es de señalar que, la mejora del presente procedimiento reside en la reducción del tiempo de fabricación, manteniendo la calidad y eficiencia del inhibidor con lo que se tendrá menor costo del producto final. Durante el procedimiento de la presente invención, la disminución del tiempo de fabricación es susceptible de realizarse en: la etapa de elaboración de la imidazolina; la etapa de elaboración del activo (carboxi-imidazolina); el periodo de reacción de obtención del activo; el procedimiento de enfriamiento de cada etapa de la síntesis; la adición de xilenos a temperatura alrededor de 110°C después de la etapa de obtención de la imidazolina; la adición de xilenos a temperatura alrededor de 110°C después de la etapa de obtención de la carboxi-imidazolina; la adición de xilenos a temperaturas entre 60- 110°C durante la etapa de formulación del inhibidor de corrosión; y la adición del isopropanol a temperatura de 55°C durante la etapa de formulación del inhibidor de corrosión. Con la mejora del presente procedimiento, se ha reducido el tiempo de obtención hasta 11 horas manteniendo la calidad y su eficiencia de protección con base en los métodos NACE TM-0172 y NACE ID182, éste último tanto en medio amargo (H2S) como dulce (CO2). Los resultados obtenidos en el escalamiento industrial de este inhibidor de corrosión, lo hacen competitivo a nivel comercial y con perspectivas de aplicación tanto en México como en otros países.

source_text: Described and claimed is a process and device for performing impact fatigue tests in different products made of cooked clay, used for evaluating the quality of said products manufactured in traditional facilities known in Mexico as ladrilleras (brick factories). Said products of cooked clay represent the way of life of many families in different regions of Mexico, and their products constituting the raw material for the manufacture of hundreds of houses in Mexico. The testing process and equipment proposed in the present patent establish the preparation of the piece to be tested so as to be mounted to the corresponding testing device, following said preparation, the impact test of the product made of clay being performed. The preparation of the tested product comprises carving two notches or grooves in these materials, and drilling two perforations. One of the perforations is intended to provide the means for fastening the product to a support, while the other perforation provides the means for fastening the tested product to a bar oriented in a vertical manner, this latter element being useful as a guide directed to a falling table that contains a perforation in the central portion thereof. The notches are performed in the mid portion of the tested product, as well as lengthwise the lower side or transversally in the upper and lower portions thereof, these are intended to induce the fracture of the product lengthwise the plane of these notches after the cooked clay product has been fixed, so that the half of the product that contains the guide bar is located in the cantilevered part thus the transversal grooves are coincident with the support edge. The quality of the product is established by the number of strikes required to fracture the tested product due to the received impact. The more strikes provided to the mass from a predetermined height, the higher the quality is in the tested materials. It has been proved that the number of strikes required for fracturi ng the tested piece is correlated to the compression resistance of the tested materials.
target_text: Se describe y reivindica un procedimiento y dispositivo para el ensaye a fatiga al impacto de productos diversos hechos de arcilla cocida, a ser empleado para evaluar la calidad de tales productos elaborados en las instalaciones tradicionales conocidas en México como "ladrilleras". Estos productos de arcilla cocida representan la forma de vida de muchas familias en las distintas regiones de México, y sus productos constituyen la materia prima para la fabricación de miles de casas en México. El procedimiento y equipo de ensayo propuestos en esta patente establecen la preparación de la pieza a ensayar para poder montarla en el dispositivo de prueba correspondiente, realizando después de esta preparación el ensaye a impacto del producto hecho de arcilla cocida. La preparación producto a ensayar comprende el tallado de dos muescas o ranuras en estos materiales, así como la realización de dos barrenos. Uno de los barrenos tiene la finalidad de proveer el medio para la sujeción del producto a un soporte o sufridera, mientras que el otro barreno tiene como finalidad proveer el medio para sujetar al producto ensayado una barra orientada de manera vertical, misma que sirve de guía a una masa caediza que contiene una perforación en su parte central. Por cuanto a las ranuras o muescas, éstas se realizan en la parte media del producto ensayado, a lo largo de su lado menor, o transversalmente, en las partes superior e inferior del mismo, y tienen el objetivo de inducir la fractura del producto a lo largo del plano de estas muescas, al quedar sujeto el producto de arcilla cocida, de tal manera que la mitad del mismo que contiene la barra guía queda en la parte en voladizo, y de tal manera que las ranuras transversales coincidan con el borde del soporte. La calidad del producto ensayado se establece a partir del conteo del número de golpes necesarios para provocar la fractura por impacto del producto ensayado. Entre mayor sea el número de golpes dados desde una altura dada de caída de la masa, mayor será la calidad de los materiales ensayados. Se ha comprobado que este número de golpes necesarios para fracturar a la pieza ensayada, correlaciona con la resistencia a la compresión de los materiales ensayados.

source_text: The invention relates to a method comprising the mechanical and chemical treatment of the small intestine of a warm-blooded vertebrate, in order to remove the mucous, serous and muscular coats and to obtain the remaining submucous coat. In short, the jejunum portion of the small intestine is obtained from a recently deceased warm-blooded vertebrate and is stored at 4°C in 0.9% saline solution. Subsequently, longitudinal scraping is performed for the initial removal of the mucous coat and it is then washed until clean. The small intestine is cut longitudinally and both surfaces are scraped in order to remove the remaining mucous coat and the muscular and serous coats, until a translucent white membrane is obtained. This is then submerged in 0.9% saline solution or distilled water and washed for 30 to 120 minutes until the blood residues disappear, constantly stirring same and changing the water every 20 minutes. Scraping is performed once again in order to eliminate the last remanents of the serous, muscular and mucous coats. It is then exposed to a mixture comprising 0.5% sodium hypochlorite and 0.5% hydrogen peroxide for 15 to 40 minutes in order to eliminate the remaining cells, constantly stirring same and observing that no obvious structural changes occur. It is washed with a phosphate buffer solution for 15 minutes, stirring constantly, and subsequently washed with 0.9% saline solution or distilled water. The membrane obtained is shaped according to use. The membranes can be used individually or to form an aggregate of multiple stacked membranes depending on the desired strength and the membranes can be given particular shapes. Following shaping, the membranes are dehydrated by means of exposure to a laminar sterile air flow. The entire method must be carried out in maximum asepsis conditions at ambient temperature. The membranes must be sterilised prior to implantation in a living organism. Said membranes can be used in maxillofacial surgery, reconstructive and plastic surgery, cardiovascular surgery, gastroenterology and urology, inter alia.
target_text: La presente invención consiste en un método en el qué se trata mecánica y químicamente el intestino delgado de un vertebrado de sangre caliente con el fin de retirar las túnicas mucosa, serosa y muscular y obtener como remanente la túnica submucosa. En resumen, se obtiene la porción del yeyuno del intestino delgado de un vertebrado de sangre caliente recién sacrificado y se almacena a 4°C en solución salina al 0.9%. Posteriormente se raspa en dirección longitudinal para hacer una remoción inicial de la túnica mucosa y se lava hasta que quede limpio. Se corta el intestino delgado en dirección longitudinal y se raspan ambas caras para remover el remanente de túnica mucosa y as túnicas muscular y serosa hasta obtener una membrana blanca y traslúcida. Se lava sumergiendo en agua destilada o solución salina al 0.9% por 30-12p minutos hasta que desaparezcan los residuos de sangre, agitando constantemente y cambiando el agua cada 20 minutos. Se raspa nuevamente para eliminar los últimos remanentes de las túnicas serosa, muscular y mucosa. Se expone a una mezcla de 0.5% hipoclorito de sodio y 0.5% peróxido de hidrógeno por 15-40 minutos para eliminar células remanentes, agitando constantemente y observando que no ocurran cambios estructurales notorios. Se lava con solución amortiguadora de fosfato por 15 minutos agitando constantemente y posteriormente se lava con agua destilada o solución salina al 0.9%. La membrana obtenida se conforma según la aplicación; pueden usarse las membranas de manera individual o formar un agregado de varias membranas superpuestas según la| resistencia deseada y además darle formas particulares a las membranas. Una vez dada la forma, se deshidratan las membranas conformadas exponiéndolas a flujo laminar de aire estéril. Todo el proceso debe llevarse a cabo en máximas condiciones de asepsia a temperatura ambiente. Las membranas deben esterilizarse antes de ser implantadas en un ser vivo. Las aplicaciones de uso de las membranas incluyen cirugía; maxilofacial, cirugía plástica y reconstructiva, cirugía cardiovascular, gastroenterología y urología

source_text: This invention provides a combination, comprising an allosteric inhibitor of MMP-13, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and a selective inhibitor of COX-2, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, that is not celecoxib or valdecoxib. This invention also provides a method of treating a disease that is responsive to inhibition of MMP-13 and cyclooxygenase-2, comprising administering to a patient suffering from such a disease the invention combination comprising an allosteric inhibitor of MMP-13, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and a selective inhibitor of COX-2, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, that is not celecoxib or valdecoxib. This invention also provides a pharmaceutical composition, comprising the invention combination comprising an allosteric inhibitor of MMP-13, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, with a selective inhibitor of COX-2, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, that is not celecoxib or valdecoxib, and a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier, diluent, or excipient. The invention further provides a combination, comprising an allosteric inhibitor of MMP-13, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, with an NSATD, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. This invention also provides a method of treating a disease that is responsive to inhibition of MMP-13 and cyclooxygenase-2, comprising administering to a patient suffering from such a disease the invention combination comprising an allosteric inhibitor of MMP-13, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, with an NSAID, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. This invention also provides a pharmaceutical composition, comprising the invention combination comprising an allosteric inhibitor of MMP-13, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, with an NSAID, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier, diluent, or excipient. The invention combinations may also be further combined with other pharmaceutical agents depending on the disease being treated.

source_text: The present invention refers to a chiltepin chile sauce and an industrial process for the manufacture of chiltepin chile sauce, which includes the following ingredients: chiltepin chilli pepper, chicken stock, milled black pepper in powder, milled coarse salt, garlic, lime, said ingredients providing a flavour and texture such as those of the best home-made sauces, as well as stability during long periods of time, and the ability of bonding, thickening and providing consistency or texture to the sauce (cohesion), with a pH (acidity or salinity) suitable for acquiring a characteristic flavour different from those of other sauces intended to be made by the same or equal process, which is packed and commercialised; the manufacturing process comprises preparing the sauce by separate in a simultaneous or sequential manner, regardless of the order: smashing the garlic without skin from 15 to 20 min, then frying the garlic at 180°C approximately, introducing into a proper container the cooke d and almost gold-coloured chiltepin chile along with the garlic, frying them for 10 to 15 min approximately at a temperature of 180°C, the chicken stock being added after frying the previous ingredients so as to form a homogeneous mixture, which is constantly stirred for avoiding lumps; the mixture is cooked for 5 minutes approximately at the same temperature (180°C), the milled coarse salt in powder being added and the mixture stirred for avoiding lumps, the lime juice being subsequently added at the same temperature and the mixture being constantly stirred for preventing the same from being adhered to the container during the whole process until it is brought to a boiling point; the sauce is then cooled at bain-marie with ice until the temperature is abruptly reduced down to 5.5°C approximately; the sauce is degreased, thus obtaining a homogeneous dispersion which is finally packed in glass containers of from about 150 mm to about 200 mm approximately, the glass containers being in troduced into boxes of 12 to 25 containers without being covered and labelled.
target_text: La presente invención se refiere a una salsa con chile chiltepín y procedimiento para la elaboración de salsa con chile chiltepín industrial, que tiene como ingredientes: chile chiltepín, concentrado de pollo, pimienta negra molida en polvo, sal de grano molida en polvo, ajo, jugo de limón sin semilla, que le da un sabor y textura como los de las mejores salsas caseras y estabilidad durante periodos prolongados de tiempo, así con capacidad de ligar, espesar y dar consistencia o textura a la salsa (ligazón) y con una verificación de pH (acidez o salinidad) apropiado para tener un sabor propio y que se diferencie de otras salsas que se quieran obtener por un procedimiento igual o parecido, para ser envasada y comercializada, donde el procedimiento de elaboración comprende preparar por separado simultáneamente o secuencialmente, en cualquier orden: picar triturando el ajo sin cáscara de 15 a 20 minutos, luego freír el ajo a 180ºC aproximadamente, en un recipiente adecuado, ya cocido casi dorado o que cambie de color, se agrega el chile chiltepín al ajo de 10 a 15 minutos aproximadamente a una temperatura de 180ºC, posteriormente y dorados los dos ingredientes se agrega el concentrado de pollo para formar una masa homogénea moviéndose constantemente para no crear grumos o bolas de la misma, dejándolo cocinar 5 minutos aproximadamente a la misma temperatura (180ºC) e incorporar sal de grano molida en polvo, se continua moviendo constantemente para no crear grumos o bolas a la misma temperatura, luego se agrega el jugo de limón sin semilla a la misma temperatura y posteriormente se continua moviendo constantemente la salsa para que no se adhiera al recipiente adecuado durante todo el procedimiento hasta que hierva, posteriormente se enfría la salsa con hielo en baño María hasta bajar bruscamente la temperatura a 5.5ºC aproximadamente, a continuación se desgrasa, obteniéndose una dispersión homogénea para finalmente envasar la salsa en frascos de vidrio de 150 a 200 mililitros aproximadamente y se empacan en cajas de 12 a 24 frascos aproximadamente sin antes tapar y etiquetar los frascos.

source_text: A mineral ionization and control system for seawater potabilization is provided, comprising: a raw or sea water influent pipeline; an ozone generator for injecting ozone into the inlet water pipe; A solids filtration assembly formed by a first filter configured to remove suspended solids and settleable solids in water, humic and fuller acids, various volatile organic compounds, fats and proteins, odor and color in water, and agrochemicals; a second organic cationic resin filter configured to recharge the cationic resin negatively and sequester 45% of the total minerals comprised of dissolved carbonated and solid salts and control the Total Dissolved Solids TSD) and the Total Hardness of the seawater; and a third multimedia filter with bituminous activated carbon configured to remove odor, flavour, chemical residues and colour (crystallisation) that may remain in the water, and positively recharge the water ions; A set of magnetic conditioners configured to generate a magnetic field which will move the salts from their equilibrium point and modify the physicochemical properties of the water; A reverse osmosis module wherein, by means of rejection and recirculation meters, the levels of electrical conductivity, TDS, total hardness and pH are timely controlled; A means for the exposure of UV light and/or ozone and/or quantum aluminum configured to purify the water from the reverse osmosis module, in compliance with the Mexican and international standards of treated water for human use and consumption; and a treated water storage and preservation tank configured to prevent the formation of algae, bacteria and cyanobacteria by means of ultrasonic equipment that emits sound waves with different frequencies, propagating at speeds of 2,000 mt/sec, thereby preventing the development of blue alga in the stored water; and a magnetic conditioner whose function is to control the minerals in the stored water; and an automated control panel for controlling the system; and/or an energy retriever to maintain a constant high pressure flow of being necessary.

source_text: Manufacturing a nucleic acid molecule comprising employing at least partially double-stranded oligonucleotide comprising a modification allowing the oligonucleotide to be coupled to a surface, a recognition site for a first type IIS restriction enzyme that cuts outside its recognition site, and a single-stranded overhang, is new. source_text: The invention relates to a rolling rod as an inner tool in the production of seamless hollow bodies, in particular in the elongation of metal hollow blocks into seamless pipes by means of a multi-stand rolling mill, having a surface having a nitrided layer. The invention further relates to a method for producing a seamlessly hot-rolled metal hollow body, in particular a steel pipe, wherein a previously produced hollow block is subjected to an elongation process in a multi-stand rolling mill over a rolling rod inserted into the hollow block, which rolling rod is described above, and the rolling rod is provided with a liquid lubricant before the rolling use, i.e., before the start of the insertion into the hollow block, which liquid lubricant is subsequently dried, wherein the rolling rod is inserted with a play of at least 10 mm with respect to the inside diameter of the hollow block and the hollow block has an average temperature of at least 1000 Â°C immediately before the start of the insertion of the rod and the rod velocity V<sub>ST</sub> during the rolling in a rod rolling mill satisfies the following conditions at most: V<sub>STmax</sub> = 0.9 x rod length / rolling time of last stand (3), V<sub>STmax</sub> = 0.9 x V<sub>Mmin</sub> (4), wherein V<sub>Mmin</sub> is the minimum velocity of the pipe material during the rolling in the rod rolling mill.

source_text: A description is given of a method and an apparatus for two-sided coating of plate-like articles (2), in particular circuit boards, in which the circuit boards (2) are transported through a plurality of successive treatment stations of a coating installation (1). In a first coating station (4), first of all a first side of the circuit boards (2) is wet-coated with, preferably, UV-curable plastic, lacquer or the like. After coating of the first side, the circuit boards (2) are in each case aired and dried in a first airing and drying station (5). The circuit boards (2) are turned, and in a second coating station (6) their second side is wet-coated with, preferably, UV-curable plastic, lacquer or the like. The circuit boards (2) coated on both sides in this way are aired and dried in a second airing and drying station (7) and finally transferred for further treatment out of the coating installation (1) to further treatment devices. In the description, the circuit boards (2) are in each case transported in opposite directions (X, Y) through the two coating stations (4, 6), which are arranged next to each other in two rows of equipment (A, B) running parallel to each other. The turning of the circuit boards (2) takes place in the first airing and drying station (5). At the same time they are also transferred from the first row of equipment (A) into the second row (B). The first airing and drying station (5) is arranged in such a way between the first and the second coating station (4, 6) that its longitudinal extent runs transversely with respect to the transporting directions (X, Y) of the circuit boards (2) in the coating stations (4, 6). Securing means (11) for the circuit boards (2) which are fastened on the upward strand (17) of a circulating conveyor (16), preferably a chain conveyor, extend transversely with respect to the first row of equipment (A), while securing means (11) which are fastened on the downward strand (18) of the circulating conveyor (16) run transversely with respect to the second row of equipment (B). <IMAGE>

source_text: A process is disclosed of obtaining a thermoplastic composition formed from a polyolefin matrix comprising a polypropylene with a fluidity index of from 2 to 100 g/10 minutes when measured at 230Â °C under 2.16 kg, and a mineral lamellar filler which is talc with a median diameter D50 of at least 1 Î1/4m, as measured by Sedigraph, and a lamellarity index of at least 4 before introduction into the matrix and at least 3 when measured in the thermoplastic composition, by dispersing the lamellar talc in the polyolefin matrix in a viscoelastic state by means of at least on compounding extruder, which process comprises (a) the formation of a viscoelastic mixture of the polypropylene matrix and the lamellar mineral talc particles by heating and kneading the said composition at a temperature at least equal to the working temperature of the polypropylene, (b) the submission of the viscoelastic mixture to thermo-mechanical work, (c) the elimination of volatile components from the viscoelastic mixture, (d) the transformation of the viscoelastic mixture resulting from step (c) into an industrially usable granulated material, characterised in that, to obtain a controlled and homogenous dispersion and distribution of the lamellar mineral talc in the polypropylene matrix, while substantially retaining initial morphological characteristics of the lamellar mineral talc particles, the viscoelastic mixture is subjected during steps (a) and (b) to a weak and controlled rate of shearing of no more than 200s<sup>-1</sup> and the viscoelastic mixture is subjected in step (b) to at least one cycle of extension and relaxation in a dedicated zone which is at least 25% of the total length of the at least one screw of the compounding extruder. Also disclosed is the use of thermoplastic compositions obtained by such process in the manufacture of products for the automotive industry, domestic appliance industry, electronic industry, building industry, construction industry, internal design industry, sport and leisure industry, in packaging or in toys.

source_text: The invention relates to a method and a machine for the production of hollow glassware, such as bottles, jars, glasses and other glass items, by means of the following processes: blowing-blowing, pressing-blowing, paste mould pressing-blowing or direct pressing, in glassware-forming machines comprising multiple sections. The inventive method comprises the following steps: a first preform or parison is formed in an inverted orientation in a parison mould and a first transferable crown mould which is supported by an inversion apparatus comprising a first arm and a second, diametrically-opposed arm which can be rotated by 180degree in an indexed manner, each of said arms supporting a crown mould; the parison supported by the first crown mould is inverted by rotating the first arm by 180degree at a vertical orientation towards an intermediary station, thereby enabling the parison to be reheated and stretched in said station, while the second arm with the second crown mould is simultaneously positioned at a parison-forming station in order to perform another parison-forming cycle; the first crown mould supporting the first parison in a vertical orientation is transferred along a semi-circular trajectory from the intermediary station to a blow-moulding station by means of a longitudinal transfer apparatus; the first parison is removed in a blow mould and the first crown mould is returned to the first arm of the inversion apparatus at the intermediary station in order to be repositioned at the parison-forming station by rotating the first arm by an additional 180degree , thereby completing a 360degree rotation, while the second arm reaches the intermediary station in order to perform a transfer cycle; the first parison is blown in a blow mould in order to form a finished product; and the finished product in a vertical orientation is transferred along a semi-circular trajectory, once the blow mould is opened, by means of an emptier such that said finished product is positioned on a dead plate for cooling and transferred to a conveyor belt.
target_text: Un metodo y una maquina para la produccion de articulos de vidrio huecos, tales como botellas, tarros, vasos y otros articulos de vidrio, por los procesos de soplo-soplo, prensa-soplo, prensa-soplo molde empastado y prensa directa en maquinas formadoras de articulos de vidrio que incluyen multiples secciones, que comprenden: formar una primera preforma o parison en una orientacion invertida, en un molde de bombillo y un primer molde de corona transferible retenido por un aparato de inversion que tiene un primero y un segundo brazos opuestos diametralmente entre si que son capaces de ser girados a 180degree en forma inadexada, cada uno de los brazos retenido un molde de corona; invertir el parison retenido por el primer molde de corona, haciendo girar el primer brazo a 180degree , a una orientacion vertical hacia una estacion intermedia, permitiendo el recalentamiento y elongacion del parison en la misma, mientras el segundo brazo con el segundo molde de corona es simultaneamente colocado en una estacion formadora de parison, para llevar a cabo otro ciclo formador de parison; transferir el primer molde de corona reteniendo el primer parison en una orientacion vertical, a traves de una trayectoria semicircular, desde la estacion intremedia, hasta una estacion de moldeo por soplo, mediante un aparato de transferencia longitudinal; liberar el primer parison en un molde de soplo, y regresar el primer molde de corona al primer brazo del aparato de inversion, en la estacion intermedia, para ser colocado de nuevo en la estacion formadora de parison mediante rotacion del primer brazo a 180degree adicionales, completando una vuelta de 360degree , mientras el segundo brazo llega a la estacion intermedia para llevar a cabo un ciclo de transferencia; soplar el primer parison en un molde de soplo, para formar un articulo acabado; y transferir el articulo acabado en una orientacion vertical, a traves de una trayectoria semicircular, una vez que el molde de soplo es abierto, por medio de un aparato secador, para colocarlo en una placa muerta para enfriar el articulo acabado y transferirlo a una banda transportadora.

source_text: This invention is in the field of the chemistry of targeting anticancer anthracycline derivatives. More particularly, it concerns doxorubicin (DOX) or its daunosamine modified derivatives (DM-DOX) linked covalently to analogs of peptide hormones such as LH-RH, bombesin and somatostatin. These covalent conjugates are targeted to various tumors bearing receptors for the peptide hormone analogs. The compounds of this invention are represented by the General Formula: Q14-O-R-P wherein Q has general formula (II) wherein: Q14 signifies a Q moiety with a side chain at the 14 position; R- is H or -C(O)-(CH2)n-C(O)- and n = 0-7; R' is NH2 or an aromatic, saturated or partially saturated 5- or 6-membered heterocyclic compound having at least one ring nitrogen and optionally having a butadiene moiety bonded to adjacent carbon atoms of said ring to form a bicyclic system; P is H or a peptide moiety, suitably an LHRH, somatostatin or bombesin analogs. Nevertheless where R' is NH2, then R and P are other than H. When R and P are H, then R' is other than NH2. A novel synthetic reaction has been discovered in the course of this work to form partially saturated heterocyclic moieties from vicinal and disjunct i.e., 'alpha','beta'- or 'alpha','gamma'-hydroxy primary amines. Q1 is DOX; Q2 is 3'-deamino-3'-(pyrrolidine-1''-yl)-doxorubicin (AN 181); Q3 is 3'-deamino-3'-(isoindoline-1''-yl)-doxorubicin (AN 184); Q4 is 3'-deamino-3'-(3''-pyrroline-1''-yl)-doxorubicin (AN 185); Q5 is 3'-deamino-3'-(3''-pyrrolidone-1''-yl)-doxorubicin (AN 191); Q6 is 3'-deamino-3'-(2''-pyrroline-1''-yl)-doxorubicin (AN 201); Q7 is 3'-deamino-3'-(3''-piperidone-1''-yl)-doxorubicin (AN 195); Q8 is 3'-deamino-3'-(1'',3''-tetrahydropyridine-1''-yl)-doxorubici n (AN 205). Q114gL is AN 152; Q614gL is AN 207; Q114gS is AN 162; Q614gS is AN 238; Q114gB is AN 160; Q614gB is AN 215.

Estos conjugados covalentes se dirigen a varios tumores portadores de receptores para los análogos de hormonas de péptidos. Sin embargo, cuando R y P son H, entonces R' debe ser distinta de NH2. Se ha descubierto una nueva reaccion sintética en el curso de este trabajo para formar partes heterocíclicas parcialmente saturadas a partir de aminas vicinales y disyuntivas, es decir alfa, beta- o alfa, y-hidroxi primarias. source_text: An oxygen or oxygen-enriched gas, pressurized, from air (2) or from an oxygen-lean gas involves is produced by using a generator (3) that generates oxygen at its outlet (4), from air introduced at its inlet (5). The generator is made of buffer tanks (6) for storing oxygen generated by generator, which are placed communicating at their inlet with generator outlet, and at their outlet with an application consuming the oxygen produced or a control system for adjusting the flow rate and/or the pressure of the oxygen produced to the demand in flow rate and/or pressure of the application. Oxygen or oxygen-enriched gas production, pressurized, from air or from an oxygen-lean gas involves using a generator that generates oxygen at its outlet, from air introduced at its inlet. The generator is made of buffer tanks for storing oxygen generated by the generator, which are placed in parallel, communicating at their inlet with the generator outlet, and at their outlet with an application consuming the oxygen produced or a control system for adjusting the flow rate and/or the pressure of the oxygen produced to the demand in flow rate and/or pressure of the application. The control system comprises a module for controlling the two buffer tanks, performing the functions: the storage in one of the buffer tanks called nominal tank, of a nominal oxygen reserve for maintaining, an oxygen outlet pressure, called nominal measure, and/or an outlet flow rate, called nominal flow rate, the storage in the other buffer tank is called other peak tank, of an oxygen peak reserve, an oxygen pressure called peak measure, which is higher than or equal to the pressure called nominal pressure, and/or an outlet flow rate, called peak flow rate, according to the oxygen pressure, demanded, which is higher than or equal to the nominal pressure, and lower than or equal to the peak pressure, and/or according to the oxygen flow rate demanded, which is higher than or equal to the nominal flow rate, and lower than or equal to the peak flow rate, an off take at the outlet of the nominal tank and/or of the peak tank, and/or the control of the generator for generating and resupplying oxygen to the nominal tank and/or the peak tank.

source_text: The invention relates to a method and a machine for the production of hollow glassware, such as bottles, jars, glasses and other glass items, by means of the following processes: blowing-blowing, pressing-blowing, paste mould pressing-blowing or direct pressing, in glassware-forming machines comprising multiple sections. source_text: A process for producing phenyl-alkanes, the process comprising the steps of: a) passing a feed stream comprising a first concentration of a first acyclic paraffin having a carbon range of C8-C28 and 2 or 3 primary carbon atoms and at least a second acyclic paraffin to an adsorption zone comprising a bed of an adsorbent comprising silicalite at adsorption promoting conditions to selectively adsorb at least a portion of the first acyclic paraffin contacting the bed of adsorbent with a desorbent stream comprising at least one component selected from the group consisting of a C5 -C8 cycloparaffin, a C5-C8 normal paraffin, and a C5- C ??8 branched paraffin and recovering from the adsorption zone an adsorption extract having a second concentration of the first acyclic paraffin that is greater than the first concentration; b) passing at least a portion of the adsorption extract to a dehydrogenation zone, operating the dehydrogenation zone at dehydrogenation conditions sufficient to dehydrogenate the first acyclic paraffin and recovering from the dehydrogenation zone a dehydrogenated product stream comprising an acyclic monoolefin having a carbon range of C8-C28 and 2 or 3 primary.carbon atoms; c) passing .a feedstock comprising a phenyl compound and passing at least a portion of the dehydrogenated product stream comprising the acyclic monoolefin to an alkylation zone, operating the alkylation zone at alkylation conditions sufficient to alkylate the phenyl compound with the acyclic monoolefin in the presence of an alkylation catalyst to form a phenyl-alkane comprising a molecule having one phenyl portion and one C8-C28 aliphatic alkyl portion; wherein the aliphatic alkyl portion has 2 or 3 primary carbon atoms and no quaternary carbon atoms that are not bonded by a carbon-carbon bond with a carbon atom of the phenyl portion; and wherein the alkylation has a selectivity to 2-phenyl-alkanes of from 40 to 100 and a selectivity to internal quaternary phenyl-alkanes of less than 10; and recovering the phenyl-alkane from the alkylation zone.

source_text: During the oil production process in the different PEP assets, these emerge contaminated with underground brines; and in the offshore assets with sea water, which is presented in two parts. One called free water, and the other part being intimately combined with crude oil in the form of an emulsion. Emulsified water gives crude oil an additional volume to transport, as well as corrosive properties which are reflected in the reduction of the useful life of the processing equipment. Due to the above, it is necessary to apply dehydration and desalting processes, the emulsion should be treated as soon as possible and there are different demulsifying agents such as heat, sedimentation, centrifugation or electro-coalescence and dehydrating chemicals. Derived from the problem that causes the water increase and the salinity in the different assets, in addition to deferring the production of heavy crude oil in order to comply with the required quality, in the research and development laborator y, the high speed and asphaltene emulsion breaker was developed. The present invention was designed specifically for the de-emulsification of heavy crude oil. The formulation comprises a mixture of: P-tert-butyl phenol from 20 to 40%, but preferably at 30%; P-Aminophenol from 4 to 15%, but preferably at 10%; Poly-alkylphenol from 5 to 15%, but preferably at 10%; Propoxylated condensed resin from 4 to 16%, but preferably at 10%; Xylene from 5 to 15%, but preferably 10%; ethylbenzene from 5 to 15%, but preferably at 10%; isopropyl alcohol from 5 to 15%, but preferably at 10%; Naphthas from 3 to 7% but preferably at 5%; Naphthalene from 3 to 7% but preferably at 5%. The high speed paraffin and asphaltenes emulsion breaker has a hydrophilic-lipophilic character partially soluble in the continuous phase (oil) and in the dispersed phase (water). This property allows that the high speed paraffin and asphaltenes emulsion breaker appropriates at the interface of the emulsion causing the ruptur e of the interfacial film surrounding the dispersed phase particles.
target_text: Durante el proceso de producción de petróleo en los diferentes activos de PEP el cual emerge contaminado con salmueras subterráneas y en los activos costafuera con agua de mar en la cual se presenta en dos partes, una llamada agua libre y la otra parte está íntimamente combinada con el crudo en forma de una emulsión. El agua emulsionada le proporciona al petróleo crudo un volumen adicional al transporte así como propiedades corrosivas el cual se ve reflejado en la reducción de la vida útil de los equipos de proceso, debido a esto es necesario aplicarle un proceso de deshidratación y desalado, la emulsión debe tratarse lo más pronto posible y existen diferentes agentes de desemulsificantes tales como calor, sedimentación, con centrifugación o electro coalescencia y químicos deshidratantes. Derivado de la problemática en el incremento del agua y la salinidad en los diferentes activos y de diferir la producción del aceite crudo pesado para poder cumplir con la calidad requerida, se realizo en nuestro laboratorio de investigación y desarrollo el rompedor de emulsión de parafinas y asfaltenos alta velocidad, diseñado específicamente para la desemulsificacion de petróleo crudo pesado. En su formulación cuenta con una mezcla de: P-Tert butil fenol 20 a 40 % preferentemente 30 % P-Amino fenol 4 a 15 % preferentemente 10 % Poli alquilen fenol 5 a 15 % preferentemente 10 % Resina condensada propoxilada 4 a 16 % preferentemente 10 % Xileno 5 a 15% preferentemente 10% Etilbenceno 5 a 15% preferentemente 10% Alcohol isopropilico 5 a 15% preferentemente 10% Naftas 3 a 7% preferentemente 5% Naftaleno 3 a 7% preferentemente 5% El rompedor de emulsión de parafinas y asfaltenos de alta velocidad es de carácter hidrofilico - lipofilico parcialmente soluble en la fase continua (aceite) y en la fase dispersa (agua), esta propiedad permite que el rompedor de emulsión de parafinas y asfaltenos de alta velocidad se posesione en la interface de la emulsión ocasionando la ruptura de la película interfacial que rodea la partículas de la fase dispersa.

source_text: A device and method for permitting the separation of plasma or serum from whole blood. The device comprises a matrix of hydrophilic sintered porous material to which at least one red blood cell agglutinating agent has been applied. According to a first method of using the device, a sample of whole blood is applied to a first end of the matrix and the red blood cells within the sample come in contact with the agglutinating agents present in the matrix. The blood cells agglutinate, and are entrapped in the interstices of the matrix, while substantially blood-cell-free serum or plasma accumulates near the outlet of the device. A filter means in liquid receiving relationship with the matrix functions to wick the serum or plasma from the matrix. According to an alternative aspect of the invention, a filter means in liquid receiving relationship with the outlet of the matrix functions to retain any blood cells which pass through the matrix as the filter means wicks the plasma or serum from the matrix. Additional agglutinating agents may be incorporated within the filter means to facilitate retention of blood cells which pass through the matrix. Another aspect of the present invention involves a device for the measurement of a serum or plasma sample, utilizing a matrix of sintered porous material, such as sintered glass, sintered steel, sintered ceramics, sintered plastics, and eguivalents thereof. The matrix is characterized by a reproducible fluid uptake capacity proportional to the fixed dimensions of said matrix, a minimal reactivity with plasma or serum components, and a hydrophilic internal surface which enables the matrix to collect and retain a predetermined volume of sample for analysis. A further aspect of the present invention provides a porous reagent delivery system comprising a matrix of sintered porous material containing at least one reagent in a freeze-dried state, and method for making same. The system allows the delivery of a unitized form of a freeze-dried reagent which is recoverable upon contact with a liquid.
target_text: UN DISPOSITIVO Y METODO PARA PERMITIR LA SEPARACION DE PLASMA O SUERO DE SANGRE COMPLETA. EL DISPOSITIVO CONSTA DE UNA MATRIZ DE MATERIAL POROSO SINTERIZADO HIDROFILICO AL QUE SE HA APLICADO AL MENOS UN AGENTE AGLUTINANTE DE CELULA DE SANGRE ROJA. DE ACUERDO CON UN PRIMER METODO PARA USAR EL DISPOSITIVO, SE APLICA UNA MUESTRA DE SANGRE ROJA A UN PRIMER EXTREMO DE LA MATRIZ Y LAS CELULAS DE SANGRE ROJA DENTRO DE LA MUESTRA ENTRAN EN CONTACTO CON LOS AGENTES AGLUTINANTES PRESENTES EN LA MATRIZ. LAS CELULAS DE SANGRE SE AGLUTINAN, Y SON OCLUIDAS EN LOS INTERSTICIOS DE LA MATRIZ, MIENTRAS EL SUERO O PLASMA ESENCIALMENTE LIBRES DE CELULAS DE SANGRE SE ACUMULAN CERCA DE LA SALIDA DEL DISPOSITIVO. UN SISTEMA DE FILTRO EN LIQUIDO ENTRA EN RELACION CON LAS FUNCIONES DE LA MATRIZ PARA EL ASCENSO DEL SUERO O PLASMA DESDE LA MATRIZ. DE ACUERDO CON UN ASPECTO ALTERNATIVO DEL INVENTO, UN SISTEMA DE FILTRO EN LIQUIDO ENTRA EN RELACION CON LA SALIDA DE LAS FUNCIONES DE LA MATRIZ PARA RETENER CUALQUIER CELULA DE SANGRE QUE PASE A TRAVES DE LA MATRIZ CUANDO EL SISTEMA DE FILTRO PRODUCE EL ASCENSO DEL PLASMA O DEL SUERO DESDE LA MATRIZ. SE PUEDEN INCORPORAR AGENTES AGLUTINANTES ADICIONALES DENTRO DEL SISTEMA DE FILTRO PARA FACILITAR LA RETENCION DE LAS CELULAS DE SANGRE QUE PASEN A TRAVES DE LA MATRIZ. OTRO ASPECTO DE ESTE INVENTO IMPLICA UN DISPOSITIVO PARA LA MEDIDA DE UNA MUESTRA DE SUERO O PLASMA, UTILIZANDO UNA MATRIZ DE MATERIAL POROSO SINTERIZADO, TAL COMO VIDRIO SINTERIZADO, ACERO SINTERIZADO, CERAMICA SINTERIZADA, PLASTICO SINTERIZADO, Y OTROS EQUIVALENTES. LA MATRIZ SE CARACTERIZA POR UNA CAPACIDAD DE SUBIDA DE FLUIDO REPRODUCIBLE PROPORCIONAL A LAS DIMENSIONES FIJAS DE DICHA MATRIZ, UNA REACTIVIDAD MINIMA CON COMPONENTES DE SUERO O PLASMA, Y UNA SUPERFICIE INTERNA HIDROFILICA QUE PERMITE A LA MATRIZ RECOGER Y RETENER UN VOLUMEN PREDETERMINADO DE MUESTRA PARA EL ANALISIS. OTRO ASPECTO DEL PRESENTE INVENTO PROPORCIONA UN SISTEMA DE DESARROLLO DE REACTIVO POROSO QUE CONSTA DE UNA MATRIZDE MATERIAL POROSO SINTERIZADO QUE CONTIENE AL MENOS UN REACTIVO EN UN ESTADO DE CONGELADO EN SECO, Y UN METODO PARA HACER LO MISMO. EL SISTEMA PERMITE EL DESARROLLO DE UN MOLDE UNIFICADO DE UN REACTIVO CONGELADO EN SECO QUE ES RECUPERABLE AL ENTRAR EN CONTACTO CON UN LIQUIDO.

source_text: The disclosure provides a composition or set of compositions and methods for producing cellular foamable, foamed, or blown perfluoropolymers or fluoropolymers and other thermoplastics to create products including a lower cost communications cable, conductor separator, conductor support-separator, jacketing, tape, wire insulation and in some cases a conduit tube as individual components or combined configurations that exhibit improved electrical, flammability and optical properties. The composition of the invention can be is chemically foamable yielding homogeneous foamed insulating structures which excel simultaneously in providing excellent insulating properties on metal wires or optical fibers, outstanding processing parameters for high speed cable manufacture and high performance ratings on flammability, smoke generation and fuel load. Specifically, the foamable perfluoropolymer cellular insulation composition comprises blending or individually utilizing; a selected perfluoropolymer in combination with magnesium carbonate, calcium carbonate and AClynÂ® wax; a second composition comprising the first composition and an additional selected one or more perfluoropolymers; a third composition comprising; talc and the selected one or more perfluoropolymers; a fourth composition comprising; the second composition, the third composition and the selected one or more perfluoropolymers. A single compounded pellet or product resulting in cellular foams obtained from melt processing the pellets has also been realized by providing the melt combination of only talc and a perfluoropolymer. The present invention includes a foamable perfluoropolymer composition comprising at least one melt-processible per(halo)fluoropolymer; and a blowing agent comprising an effective amount of magnesium carbonate; and an active nucleating agent chosen among: at least one metal carbonate different from magnesium carbonate having decomposition temperature exceeding 350Â°C, generally chosen among CaCO3, BaCO3, ZnCO3 and PbCO3; and talc and mixtures thereof.
target_text: La descripción proporciona composición o conjunto de composiciones y métodos para producir perfluoropolímeros o fluoropolímeros espumables celulares, espumados o soplados y otros termoplásticos, para crear productos incluyendo un cable de comunicaciones, separador conductor, soporte-separador conductor, enchaquetado, cinta, aislamiento de alambre y en algunos casos un tubo de conducto que contiene componentes individuales o configuraciones combinadas que exhiben mejoradas propiedades eléctricas de inflamabilidad y ópticas a menor costo. La composición de la invención es químicamente espumable dando por resultado estructuras aislantes espumadas homogéneas que son excelentes en forma simultánea para proporcionar excelentes propiedades aislantes en alambres de metal o fibras ópticas, sobresalientes parámetros de procesamiento para fabricación de cable a alta velocidad y capacidades nominales o regímenes de servicio de alto desempeño en inflamabilidad, generación de humo y carga de combustible. Específicamente, la composición de aislamiento celular de perfluoropolímero espumable comprende mezclar o emplear en forma individual un perfluoropolímero selecto en combinación con carbonato de magnesio, carbonato de calcio y cera AClyn(r), una segunda composición que comprende la primer composición y uno adicional seleccionado de uno o más perfluoropolímeros; una tercer composición que comprende talco y el uno o más perfluoropolímeros seleccionados, una cuarta composición que comprende: la segunda composición, la tercer composición y el uno o más perfluoropolímeros selectos. Un gránulo o producto formulado sencillo que resulta en espumas celulares que se obtienen a partir del procesamiento de fusión de los gránulos, también se ha logrado al proporcionar la combinación de fusión de solo talco y un perfluoropolímero. La presente invención incluye una composición de perfluoropolímero espumable que comprende cuando menos un per(halo)fluoropolímero procesable en fusión; y un agente de soplado que comprende una cantidad efectiva de carbonato de magnesio; y un agente nucleante activo seleccionado de entre: cuando menos un carbonato de metal diferente de carbonato de magnesio, que tiene una temperatura de descomposición que excede 350ºC, seleccionado generalmente entre CaCO3, BaCO3, ZnCO3 y PbCO3; y talco y sus mezclas.

source_text: The present invention provides a process that consists of 4 equipment for capturing the carbon dioxide of a stream of combustion gases coming from the burning of bituminous coal, producing a product of high purity (> 95 mol %) by means of an absorption/desorption system with a solvent consisting of a mixture of choline/urea chloride (1: 2) with water. The process comprises the absorption of CO2 in an absorption column where the combustion gases are fed at the bottom of the column and 31523 kmol/h of solvent with a molar fraction of 0.769 of water and 0.231 of choline/urea chloride (1: 2) at a temperature of 43Â °C The absorption column has 66 total stages, a first packing section with 28 stages, a second packing section with 17 stages, a total height of 40.8 meters and a diameter of 2.8 meters and operates with a pressure of 13.7 atmospheres. The CO2-enriched solvent passes to the regeneration equipment where, by means of changes in temperature and pressure, the desired purity of the product is reached and the gases are separated from the solvent. The first separator operates at a pressure of 2.5 atmospheres and a temperature of 15.9 Â ° C, with a thermal load of -71638 kW. The second separator operates with a pressure of 4.9 atmospheres and a temperature of 51.8Â ° C, with a thermal load of 71308 kW. The invention relates to a column for the desorption of glucose by the production of one mole of levulinic acid, one mole of formic acid and another of water, by means of a first device (reactive distillation column). The column contains 5 total stages including the condenser and the reboiler, with a height of 1.8 meters and a diameter of 0.9 meters. The enriched solvent is fed in step 4. The reboiler heats the solvent to 89Â ° C, with a thermal load of 52844 kW and operates with a reflux ratio of 0.1 to 1 atmospheric pressure. On the dome, a styled flow of 1377 kmol/h with a purity of 95 mol % CO2 is obtained. The mixture of the solvent choline chloride/urea (1: 2) and water exits via the bottom of the desorption column.
target_text: La presente invención proporciona un proceso que costa de 4 equipos para la captura del dióxido de carbono de una corriente de gases de combustión proveniente de la quema de carbón bituminoso, produciendo un producto de alta pureza (>95% molar) mediante un sistema de absorción/desorción con un disolvente que consiste en una mezcla de cloruro de colina/urea (1:2) con agua. La columna de absorción tiene 66 etapas totales, una primera sección de empacado con 28 etapas, una segunda sección de empacado con 17 etapas, una altura total de 40.8 metros y un diámetro de 2.8 metros y opera con una presión de 13.7 atmósferas. El disolvente enriquecido con CO2 pasa a los equipos de regeneración donde mediante cambios en temperatura y presión se llega a la pureza deseada del producto y se separan los gases del disolvente. El primer separador opera a una presión de 2.5 atmósferas y una temperatura de 15.9 °C, con una carga térmica de -71638 kW. El segundo separador opera con una presión de 4.9 atmósferas y una temperatura de 51.8°C, con una carga térmica de 71308 kW. La columna de desorción de glucosa, por la producción de un mol de ácido levulínico, un mol de ácido fórmico y otro de agua, a través de un primer equipo (columna de destilación reactiva). La columna contiene 5 etapas totales incluyendo el condensador y el rehervidor, con una altura de 1.8 metros y un diámetro de 0.9 metros. El disolvente enriquecido se alimenta en la etapa 4. El rehervidor calienta el disolvente a 89°C, con una carga térmica de 52844 kW y opera con una relación de reflujo de 0.1 a 1 atmósfera de presión.
